_help: Maps the TAG: line of each MCQ to the Main > Sub > Minor tree. Keys are case-insensitive. 'main' = letter A-H, 'sub' = exact subtopic name from topics.json, 'minor' is optional (defaults to the tag text itself, so it appears as its own chip). Tags that are NOT listed here are auto-matched against names in topics.json; anything still unmatched lands in 'Other / Unsorted' and the converter prints a warning telling you which tags to add here.
